docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I am a Geospatial AI Data Scientist with a strong background in Remote Sensing and GIS, bringing 6 years of professional experience in Earth Observation, satellite image analysis, SAR/InSAR, UAV mapping, and geospatial analytics. I develop data-driven geospatial solutions for environmental monitoring, disaster management, infrastructure assessment, and natural resource management using Python, ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth Engine, and modern geospatial technologies.

I am passionate about combining geospatial data, artificial intelligence, and computer vision to automate spatial analysis and generate actionable insights from Earth observation data. I am currently seeking international opportunities in Geospatial AI, Remote Sensing, GIS, SAR and Earth Observation, where I can contribute to innovative, real-world geospatial solutions.

docs.title: SAR Engineer — Eartheye Space
docs.text:
Apr 2025 – Nov 2025 | Bangalore, India

  • Developed an automated oil spill detection pipeline using Very High Resolution SAR data (Capella, Umbra, ICEYE), cutting processing and delivery time from 1 hour to 1 minute
  • Designed automated pipelines for flood detection, soil moisture estimation (X/C/L-band SAR), blank spot detection, and path detection in plantation areas
  • Performed DInSAR surface deformation analysis, optical-SAR data co-registration, radar-backscatter change detection (deforestation, river ice, wildfires), vessel detection, and methane extraction from Sentinel-5 data

docs.title: Junior Research Fellow — National Hydrology Project, National Remote Sensing Centre (ISRO)
docs.text:
Aug 2023 – Mar 2025 | Hyderabad, India

  • Identified dam subsidence using SBAS InSAR on SAR SLC data within a Python/Jupyter workflow, reducing computation time from weeks to days
  • Conducted flood mapping and analysis using multi-sensor SAR and optical datasets (RCM 3, TerraSAR, COSMO-SkyMed, Gaofen-3, ALOS-PALSAR-2, Worldview, GeoEye, KOMPSAT), producing FCC images and 3D animations
  • Generated DEMs via InSAR and CartoSAT-3 photogrammetry for landslide volume estimation; carried out flood modeling (MIKE, HEC-RAS) and flood risk/hazard assessment
  • Built an HTML/JavaScript/CSS swipe tool for shareable map comparisons

docs.title: Junior Research Fellow — Biodiversity Characterization Project, National Remote Sensing Centre (ISRO)
docs.text:
Sep 2022 – Aug 2023 | Hyderabad, India

  • Performed decadal LULC change detection and landscape analysis (FRAGSTATS, MSPA) in QGIS, including raster/vector processing and classification
  • Conducted Species Distribution Modeling for invasive alien plant species and mapped Chromolaena odorata using WorldView-2 data via pixel-based, object-based, and machine learning (Random Forest) methods
  • Calculated Transform Divergence Index to improve classification accuracy, mapped burnt areas and fire hotspot trends, and analyzed NDVI-based phenology metrics
  • Led field biodiversity surveys across multiple forest plots and mapped alpha diversity at the community level

docs.title: Technical Service Engineer — North Eastern Space Applications Centre, Dept. of Space

Aug 2020 – Sep 2022 | Meghalaya, India

  • Mapped tourism assets at 1:5000 scale and developed a tourism potential index using multi-criteria overlay analysis; built an HTML/JavaScript/CSS webpage for the project
  • Prepared village resource maps using KOMPSAT-2 imagery at 1:2000 scale
  • Processed UAV data with DGPS-based GCP setup for wetland mapping at 1:300 scale
  • Interpreted LULC, drainage, settlement, and mining features from satellite imagery at 1:500 scale for a coal mining project

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This project demonstrates building instance segmentation from high-resolution aerial imagery using the GeoAI framework. A Mask R-CNN model was trained on building footprint data to detect individual buildings, generate segmentation masks, and convert predictions into vector polygons for geospatial analysis.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Building instance segmentation
  • Mask R-CNN deep learning model
  • Training using building footprint annotations
  • Prediction on unseen aerial imagery
  • Polygon vectorization of detected buildings
  • Visualization and geometric property analysis

docs.title: Project Workflow
docs.text:
1. Download aerial imagery and building footprint data.
  2. Generate image tiles for model training.
  3. Train the Mask R-CNN instance segmentation model.
  4. Perform inference on test imagery.
  5. Generate building masks.
  6. Convert masks into GeoJSON polygons.
  7. Calculate geometric properties and visualize results.

docs.title: Tamil Nadu Crop Mapping using Deep Learning
Overview
docs.text: This project demonstrates a crop mapping workflow using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery over an agricultural region in Tamil Nadu. The workflow includes satellite data acquisition, image preprocessing, temporal comparison, spectral analysis, and crop classification to identify agricultural patterns.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Download Sentinel-2 imagery using STAC API
  • Satellite image preprocessing and normalization
  • Temporal comparison of multi-date imagery
  • Spectral index calculation
  • Crop classification workflow
  • Visualization of crop mapping results

docs.title: Project Workflow
docs.text:
1. Define the study area.
  2. Download Sentinel-2 satellite imagery.
  3. Preprocess and normalize the imagery.
  4. Compare multi-temporal satellite images.
  5. Calculate spectral indices.
  6. Perform crop classification.
  7. Visualize the mapping results.

docs.title: Ship Detection in Satellite Imagery using YOLOv8
Overview
docs.text: This project focuses on detecting ships in satellite imagery using the YOLOv8 object detection model. A pretrained YOLOv8s model was fine-tuned on a Kaggle ship detection dataset to identify ships in unseen satellite images. The project demonstrates the complete workflow from dataset preparation to model training and inference.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Ship detection in satellite images
  • Fine-tuned YOLOv8s model
  • Training on a Kaggle dataset
  • Detection on unseen test images
  • Confidence threshold comparison during inference

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Prepare and organize the dataset.
  2. Configure the dataset using a YAML file.
  3. Train the YOLOv8s model.
  4. Validate the trained model.
  5. Perform inference on test images.
  6. Visualize the detection results.

  • Tree size classification
  • Template matching for feature extraction
  • Visualization of detection results

  5. Count detected trees.
  6. Classify trees based on template size.

docs.title: Water Body Semantic Segmentation using GeoAI
Overview
docs.text: This project demonstrates semantic segmentation of water bodies from satellite imagery using the GeoAI framework. A U-Net model with a ResNet34 encoder was trained to classify each pixel as either water or background, enabling accurate extraction of water bodies from remote sensing imagery.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Semantic segmentation of water bodies
  • U-Net architecture with ResNet34 encoder
  • Pixel-wise classification
  • Model training and evaluation
  • Prediction on unseen satellite images
  • Visualization of segmentation results

docs.title: Project Workflow
docs.text:
1. Prepare satellite images and segmentation masks.
  2. Train the U-Net segmentation model.
  3. Evaluate model performance.
  4. Perform semantic segmentation inference.
  5. Compare predictions with ground truth masks.
  6. Visualize segmentation outputs.
